description: Damage cost per tonne of pollutant emitted. EEA rows: low = VOLY (value of a life year) valuation, high = VSL (value of statistical life); the EEA publishes no central value. Defra rows: low, central and high as published (UK only).

usage.europe: Country rows from the EEA table (EUR, 2021 prices). The app uses VOLY as central and labels it so.
usage.uk: Defra 2025 national averages (GBP, 2025 prices), converted to EUR with data/static/fx.json.
usage.elsewhere: No official values: the EEA38+UK average is shown as a rough transfer from European values, after tonnes.
